title: Petition of Boston Gas Company for a determination under G.L. c. 92, § 43 that the public convenience and necessity require certain locations within boulevards and reservations in the care and control of the Metropolitan District Commission in the Town of Brookline, Massachusetts, namely, West Roxbury Parkway, be used for a distance of approximately 240 feet for the installation and operation of a four-inch gas main and related facilities to be used for the distribution of gas.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
